normalization.formula: normalized = (source_coordinate - global_center) / global_scale; one transform applies to every neuron

simplification.algorithm: roots, leaves and branch points retained; 3D Ramer-Douglas-Peucker on linear chains; long source segments retained

metadata.limitations: Centerlines are real official morphology. Roles and activity are MetroFly visualization choices. Missing skeletons are omitted, never fabricated.
